sources.extraction_rule: After public registration, transcribe the experimental central interval and its explicitly reported uncertainty for each isotope from the source's experiment-comparison material. sources.ambiguity_rule: If more than one experimental value is tabulated, use the value explicitly selected or recommended by the source authors; if none is selected, stop with PROVENANCE_FAILURE rather than choosing after viewing numerical agreement.
